spec.claim_summary: Go long BTC on 4H when Supertrend flips from downtrend to uptrend with an ATR stop, partial take at 0.75R with stop moved to breakeven, and remaining closed on opposite Supertrend flip.
assumptions: Timeframe 4H and asset BTCUSD taken from claim text.
Supertrend settings not stated: used defaults ATR length 10 and multiplier 3.
Uptrend defined as close above Supertrend; flip down-to-up encoded as close crosses_above Supertrend.
Flip up-to-down encoded as close crosses_below Supertrend.
ATR stop-loss multiplier not stated: used 3 x ATR(14).
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: partial exit of half position at 0.75R - schema closes full position only, so partial target omitted and remainder exit on opposite Supertrend flip kept as the testable core.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving stop loss to breakeven after first target hit.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: position sizing / holding half size after partial; engine tests one full position at a time.
Test window 2020-01-02 to 2023-01-05 is backtest context, not part of rule; recorded in claimed.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Claim requires partial take of half position at 0.75R, but spec leaves take_profit_r null and omits it as NOT EXPRESSIBLE. This changes risk/reward and win-rate of tested rule.

exit[0]: Claim exits remaining half after moving stop to breakeven following 0.75R partial; spec tests full position to opposite Supertrend flip with ATR stop only and no breakeven move, which changes what is being tested.
